titulo.estudio: Une lettre de réclamation : Repérer les informations
titulo.alumno: A formal complaint: Finding the details

intro: Recognise the problem, the evidence cited and the solution requested in a complaint. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

texto: Recognise the problem, the evidence cited and the solution requested in a complaint. Separate the fact from its context: verb tenses, connectors and who says what show when and by whom each piece of information is given.
Watch out: polite formulas keep a formal register; « en effet » introduces evidence and « par conséquent » a request. In this passage, «reçu» means «receipt».

frases.estudio: Madame, je vous écris au sujet de la commande reçue le 4 avril, dont l'emballage était endommagé.
frases.alumno: Dear Madam, I am writing about the order received on 4 April, whose packaging was damaged.

frases.estudio: J'ai joint une photographie ainsi qu'une copie du reçu à ce message.
frases.alumno: I have attached a photograph and a copy of the receipt to this message.
